TC-2702-02 Black-box / real-device Expand an existing reply thread and tap Like on a reply Icon and count update; backend accepts the toggle Count changed 0 → 1 → 0 after the second tap Passed
TC-2702-03 Gray-box Validate UI callback to API integration UI invokes the comment-like action and restores state after the second toggle CommentsSheet invokes onToggleLike; hook calls POST /comments/like/{commentSlug} and applies optimistic update/rollback Passed
TC-2702-04 White-box Review comment/reply branching and failure handling Correct list branch updates and failed request reverts UI Top-level comments update comments; replies update replyThreads[parentId]; API rejection flips state back and shows an error Passed

Code review

Area Evidence Result
API contract toggleCommentLike(commentSlug) posts to /comments/like/{commentSlug} Correct endpoint integration
Comment UI Each comment passes its id to onToggleLike(item.id) Correct
Reply UI Each reply passes its id and parent id to onToggleLike(reply.id, item.id) Correct
State integrity Optimistic change increments/decrements one count; rejected request reverses the same operation Correct

This is a deterministic state-toggle flow, not a classifier; TP/FP/TN/FN metrics are not applicable. Positive and negative transitions were instead verified directly: unlike-to-like and like-to-unlike for both a comment and a reply.
